crossRefs.note: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

translations.web: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
translations.bsb: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”
translations.kjv: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
translations.asv: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, And the discernment of the discerning will I bring to nought.
